prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART character review board. Uniform neutral medium grey opaque backdrop. Exactly two columns: front-left full body and matching back-right full body of SAME person per row. Different rows are independent people, no interaction. Compact stocky game sprite proportions and conspicuously chunky square pixel clusters, simple 3-tone clothing, selective dark outline, small simple faces. Muted earth wool, linen and worn leather; simple medieval round/tie neck cuts. No modern lapels, suits, uniforms, medical symbols, fantasy ornament, magic, text, labels, border, scenery, agreement, payment or resolved quest. All appearance, hair, exact age, and gender where source unspecified are proposals, not narrative canon. No invented injuries or diagnoses. Native grid, palette, animation and runtime unverified. THREE rows. TOP BUZE adult male old-house ownership claimant, mature stubbled face, short dark hair, ochre wool tunic and worn brown vest with simple ties, empty hands. MIDDLE RUYA adult female buyer handling one finite bridge-timber order, dark braid, slate-blue travel tunic and muted russet short cloak, closed modest leather folio. BOTTOM DAILI adult female resident caretaker of old timber house, grey-streaked hair and linen cap, faded olive dress with brown work apron, one personal simple iron key in closed hand. No beam dismantling, new house promise fulfilled, paid deposit or forced relocation.
